svg.title: The clock starts at the ad click
svg.desc: Timeline from day 0 to day 35 for an example lead. Day 0: ad click and form submission. Day 6: the lead is qualified. Day 24: the deal is won. Bands show Google Ads' default 30-day click-through conversion window, Meta's guidance that a Conversions API for CRM optimization stage should happen within 28 days of the lead, and Meta's rule that an event's event_time can be at most 7 days old when you send it, so stages should be uploaded at least daily.
svg.text: The clock starts at the ad click
An example lead (illustrative days) against the windows Google and Meta publish.

g.text: gclid / fbc saved with the lead

svg.text: Google Ads default click-through conversion window: 30 days
Meta CRM integration: optimize on a stage within 28 days of the lead
event_time can't be older than this →
Sources: Google Ads Help, conversion windows; Meta for Developers, Conversions API for CRM and server event parameters. Days are illustrative.
